title: M0 · Recon & Bootstrap
description: Prerequisites, Kiro/Crew/LLM/XSD/dataset recon with recorded fixtures, repo + CI, local stack, Render deploy of a hello build, load spike, .kiro steering and spec scaffold.

title: M1 · Walking Skeleton
description: Domain core with provenance invariants, schema, identity, jobs, observability, design system, and a thin upload → health report → export slice deployed to production.

title: M2 · Core Loop
description: All ingest formats, rule packs, structuring, LLM labeller, review queue, linking, pre-flight and export. The demo storyboard runs for real on production.

title: M3 · Developer Surfaces & Proof
description: API tokens, MCP server, Kiro power, Crew app, Kiro hooks and agent, hand-labelled accuracy, load test, judge sandboxes, accessibility, live LLM eval, privacy.

title: M4 · Submission
description: README, Kiro write-up, video, blog, Devpost text, public-tree cleanup, final gate from a clean clone, then submit (deadline 4 Dec 14:00 PT).
